scope.exclusions: Batches outside 36–60, named/generated portraits, company/MIO art and gameplay/technical validation belong to other reviewers.

rules.prompts: Each batch-XX.json subject/material prompt and every distinct shared exclusion suffix were read; no reliance on stored approved/review claims.

method: Every final-review/batch-36.png through batch-60.png was actually opened using view_image detail=original. Each source thumbnail and native-game-size export was visually inspected against its named subject and material direction.

Suspect mechanical parts, emblems, colored rims, anatomy and technical edge candidates were opened from their manifest-selected PNG source at original detail. Full-size confirmations and rejected suspicions are listed separately.
Python was used only to create neutral-background inspection composites and crops inside final-review/inspection-36-60. Original art, exports, gameplay and manifests were not changed.

Source SHA256 was captured before visual review and rechecked after the initial 235-asset pass: all matched and matched manifest hash baselines at that checkpoint. Hashes identify reviewed evidence; they are not a substitute for visual inspection.

Small symbolic mechanisms, ordinary perspective simplification, diagram dots/rules, actual arithmetic/music, generic material ornament and intentional cloud/terrain motifs were not automatically treated as defects.

priorityDefinitions.P1: Severe unambiguous identity/lore/anatomy failure requiring immediate replacement; none assigned in this review.
priorityDefinitions.P2: Credible visible defect or explicit prompt-rule conflict warranting correction/review. A medium-confidence suspected occupant is explicitly marked uncertain.
priorityDefinitions.P3: Minor palette compliance issue; recognizable and usable subject, lower correction priority.

summary.notDetected: No credible Earth map, invented crown/lily/national arms, unreadable pseudo-text, floating bonus overlay or malformed principal mechanism found in this range. No source-exterior halo confirmed in the neutral-background follow-ups.
summary.limitations: A complete sheet-level semantic/artifact audit with targeted full-size follow-up, not full-size inspection of every source. Native previews were reviewed, not an in-game runtime session. Findings apply to the recorded source hashes; later main-agent fixes require their own verification.

findings.location: Gear perimeter, lever, masonry/gate edges; blue right-hand perimeter
findings.observation: Bright gold/orange edge lighting repeats across unrelated stone and steel surfaces, with blue opposite rim. This contradicts sparse material-specific highlights and the prohibition on a uniform rim/cobalt treatment.
findings.nativeImpact: Gold outline remains prominent at 64x64 and makes this icon look distinctly emissive next to the restrained set.

Use matte charcoal iron, neutral grey stone and a subdued dark red lever grip under neutral diffuse light. Apply sparse silver wear only to exposed steel edges. No gold/orange rim, cobalt edge light, glow or enclosing outline. Keep a clean transparent exterior and the same compact silhouette.

findings.location: Circular emblem at bottom of timetable; large foreground key

findings.correctivePrompt: Retain the adult office chair, handover key and peace timetable. Replace the entire dove/branch/circle emblem with a final plain square milestone connected to the existing timetable line; no bird, foliage, seal, crest or logo. Make the key grey iron with sparse silver wear and only tiny oxidised-brass fitting edges. Keep natural walnut/leather, ivory paper, pale stone and transparent exterior.

findings.location: Topmost steel upright at upper edge and foreground paved base at lower edge

findings.nativeImpact: At 64px the high frame and lower pavement sit abruptly at the composition limits. Current export accurately preserves the source limitation.
findings.correctivePrompt: Preserve the unfinished apartment frame, external builder's hoist and small street-corner base. Zoom out so the full highest upright and its cap, entire hoist and complete finite paving base are visible. Leave at least 8 percent transparent margin on all sides.
